title: should render waterfall span-event markers and a tree count badge for an error span
verifies: a span carrying an exception event renders a severity-error waterfall marker and a tree count badge of 1

title: should open the sidebar Events tab and expand the matching event row when a marker is clicked
verifies: clicking a waterfall marker opens the sidebar Events tab, re-plots the event on the mini-timeline, and expands the matching row

title: should render the tree badge error variant with a trailing error tally of 1
verifies: the tree badge renders its error-outline variant with a trailing error count of 1 for the error span

title: should show a sidebar mini-timeline whose marker count matches the events-table row count
verifies: manually opening a span's Events tab shows a mini-timeline whose marker count equals the events-table row count

title: should show the no-events empty state for a span without an events payload
verifies: selecting the root span (no events) shows the no-events empty state and zero mini-timeline markers

title: should render info and warning severity markers from level/severity_text events — not wired: no e2e ingest payload produces level/severity_text events (trace-ingestion.js:122-138)
verifies: info/warning severity markers render once an ingest payload carries level/severity_text events (parked as fixme)
